SEs learn about poor demos too late (during lost deal post-mortems). No NPS baseline or tracking. Managers cannot coach effectively without data. Quality issues repeat because feedback loop is broken.
businessCase.opportunity: Automated NPS system provides instant feedback on every demo. 80% response rate creates rich dataset for coaching and improvement. Real-time alerts on low scores enable immediate damage control. Trend analysis identifies top performers and struggling SEs. Data-driven coaching improves demo quality systematically. 4.5/5 target drives continuous improvement culture.
businessCase.solution: Automated survey sent 24 hours post-demo asks: 'How satisfied were you with the demo? (1-5)' + open-ended feedback. Dashboard shows NPS trends by product/SE/region. Low scores (<3/5) trigger instant alerts to SE and manager for follow-up call. CRM integration links satisfaction to deal outcomes. Monthly reports guide coaching priorities.
businessCase.roi: Demo quality improvement: 4.5/5 satisfaction drives higher conversion rates (estimated $300K+ pipeline impact). SE coaching effectiveness: Data-driven insights replace guesswork. Risk mitigation: Real-time alerts prevent negative prospect experiences from killing deals. Culture impact: Continuous feedback loop drives excellence.

topRisks.mitigation: Personalize survey invite from SE (not generic automation). Keep survey ultra-short (2 questions, <60 seconds). Offer incentive for completion (e.g., priority support). Send reminder if no response within 48 hours. A/B test subject lines.

topRisks.risk: Alert fatigue - too many low-score alerts overwhelm SEs, ignored over time
topRisks.mitigation: Only alert on scores <3/5 (truly poor demos). Route alerts to SE first, escalate to manager only if no action within 24 hours. Weekly digest for moderate scores (3-4/5) instead of instant alerts.

businessCase.roi: Lead generation: 100+ qualified leads/month  25% conversion  $50K ACV = $1.25M+ annual pipeline. Sales velocity: Pre-qualified leads convert 30% faster = 2-3 week deal cycle reduction = $300K+ revenue acceleration. SE productivity: Eliminate 40% unqualified demo requests = 8 hours/week saved across team = $160K annual value. Marketing ROI: Website traffic  demo engagement  3x lead conversion improvement. Competitive win rate: Instant demo access vs competitors' delays = 15%+ win rate lift on fast-moving deals.

topRisks.risk: Security breach - prospect RBAC misconfigured, unauthorized access to internal demo assets or customer data
topRisks.mitigation: Security Analyst validates RBAC rules before launch. Azure AD B2C industry-standard authentication (not custom auth). Separate prospect environments from internal (zero trust architecture). Quarterly penetration testing. Audit logs for all access. Data classification: Public vs Internal vs Confidential demo assets.

topRisks.risk: Lead quality low - tire-kickers overwhelm Sales with unqualified demo requests, Sales rejects platform
topRisks.mitigation: Lead scoring model: Require company email (no Gmail/Yahoo), company size field, budget timeline. Progressive profiling: More questions for high-value demos. Sales approval gate for premium demos. Marketing Ops reviews lead quality monthly, adjusts form fields. CRM lead routing rules: Only qualified leads to Sales, others to Marketing nurture.

topRisks.risk: Content gaps - demo library incomplete, prospects request products with no assets, poor experience
topRisks.mitigation: Phase 1 launches with minimum 20 demo assets (cover top products). SE content creation sprints: 2 demos/week upload target. Demo asset priority matrix: High-demand products first. Placeholder content for gaps: 'Coming Soon' with email notification signup. Quarterly content audits: Retire outdated demos, refresh top performers.

initiatives.name: Demo Technology Enablement: Tiled, Synthesia & Coast Rollout

smartGoal.statement: Deploy Tiled, Synthesia, and Coast demo technologies across three Sales Growth Offices (Capital Markets, Banking, International Banking) with licenses, training, and demo-to-deal tracking, delivering 30 production demos (10 per BU) by December 2026 prioritized by economy of impact: Tiled first, Synthesia second, Coast third.

objectives: Procure and deploy Tiled licenses across 3 Sales Growth Offices (Capital Markets, Banking, Int. Banking) - PRIORITY 1
Procure and deploy Synthesia licenses for AI video generation post-demo automation - PRIORITY 2
Expand Coast licenses for virtualization (coordinated with existing deployment) - PRIORITY 3
Deliver SE training programs: Tiled (interactive demos), Synthesia (video creation), Coast (environment management)
Establish demo-to-deal tracking: Connect all demos built to CRM opportunities via OID linkage
Build 30 production demos: 10 per Sales Growth Office (Capital Markets, Banking, Int. Banking) across all 3 platforms
Create demo development workflow: Review  Design  Draft  Build  Review  Release (standard process per platform)
Track progress via Gantt charts: Per-org workstreams showing demo pipeline status

metrics: 30 production demos delivered by Dec 2026 (10 Capital Markets, 10 Banking, 10 Int. Banking)
100% SE training completion: Tiled certification (all SEs), Synthesia (content creators), Coast (technical SEs)
Demo-to-deal tracking: 90% of demos linked to CRM opportunities via OID field
Platform adoption: Tiled 80% utilization, Synthesia 60% post-demo usage, Coast 40% (per existing migration plan)
Time-to-demo reduction: 40% faster demo build cycle using Tiled vs legacy tools
License ROI: $300K platform investment  $1M+ revenue influenced via demos

achievable.resources: Tiled licenses (priority 1 budget allocation), Synthesia API licenses, Coast expansion (linked to Initiative #9 contract), vendor training programs, demo development workflow, Gantt project tracking, CRM integration for demo tracking
achievable.teamSize: Head of Tech @ 75%, 3 BU Pre-Sales Leads @ 50% each, 3 Developers @ 50%, Demo Ops @ 100%, Vendor Training Teams (48 weeks)

timeline.deliverable: Tiled licenses procured; SE training completed; demo development workflow established; 12 Tiled demos delivered (4 per BU); Gantt tracking per org
Synthesia API licenses deployed; content creator training; 9 AI video demos created (3 per BU); post-demo automation integrated
Coast expansion (coordinated with Initiative #9); 9 virtualized demos deployed (3 per BU); environment management training
All 30 demos linked to CRM via OID tracking; Gantt project completion across all 3 BUs; platform adoption metrics validated; ROI report to CRO

businessCase.problem: Demo technology adoption fragmented across Sales Growth Offices. Capital Markets, Banking, and Int. Banking lack standardized platforms for interactive demos (Tiled), AI video follow-up (Synthesia), and virtualized environments (Coast). Each BU builds demos ad-hoc using outdated tools. No centralized tracking of demos-to-deals - cannot prove demo ROI. Manual demo creation slow (blocks sales velocity). Zero visibility into demo pipeline across BUs. No training programs - SEs learn platforms informally.
businessCase.opportunity: Unified technology enablement transforms demo operations: Tiled accelerates interactive demo builds (40% faster vs legacy tools). Synthesia automates post-demo video follow-up (supports Initiative #8). Coast virtualization reduces infrastructure costs (supports Initiative #9). 30 production demos across 3 BUs = standardized library. Demo-to-deal tracking proves ROI to Finance. Gantt visibility shows pipeline status per BU. SE training ensures platform adoption. Economy of impact prioritization: Tiled (immediate velocity), Synthesia (automation), Coast (long-term infrastructure).
businessCase.solution: Phased rollout prioritized by impact: (1) Tiled deployment + training + 12 demos across 3 BUs (Q1-Q2). (2) Synthesia API + content creator training + 9 video demos (Q3). (3) Coast expansion + technical training + 9 virtualized demos (Q4). Demo-to-deal tracking via CRM OID linkage. Gantt charts track per-BU progress through Review  Design  Draft  Build  Review  Release workflow. Budget already allocated in app - embed/link to initiative.
businessCase.roi: Demo velocity: 30 demos  $150K avg influenced revenue = $4.5M pipeline. Platform efficiency: Tiled 40% faster builds = 10 hours/week saved per SE = $200K annual value. Synthesia automation: Post-demo videos drive 85% engagement (Initiative #8 ROI). Coast infrastructure: $180K/year savings (Initiative #9 benefit). Training investment: $50K enables $4.5M+ pipeline (90:1 ROI). Multi-BU scalability: Standardized platforms enable cross-BU demo sharing.

budget.notes: Budget already allocated in application - embed or link to existing budget tracking system. Estimated ~$300K for licenses (Tiled, Synthesia, Coast expansion) + training + development resources.

topRisks.risk: BU adoption varies - one org embraces platforms, others revert to legacy tools, fragmentation continues
topRisks.mitigation: CRO mandate: All new demos must use approved platforms (Tiled/Synthesia/Coast only). BU Pre-Sales Leads co-owners (accountability per org). Monthly adoption tracking per BU. Gamification: Leaderboard showing demo production by BU. Success stories from early adopters shared cross-BU. Disable legacy demo infrastructure after 6-month transition.

topRisks.risk: 30-demo target unrealistic - teams overcommitted, quality suffers, SEs burn out
topRisks.mitigation: Gantt charts track realistic capacity per BU (10 demos/year = <1 per month sustainable). Prioritize high-impact products (top 10 per BU via Sales Growth Office input). Demo development workflow prevents scope creep. Demo Ops @ 100% dedicated support. Flex timeline if capacity constraints emerge - quality over velocity.

topRisks.risk: Demo-to-deal tracking adoption fails - SEs skip OID linkage, cannot prove ROI
topRisks.mitigation: Leverage Initiative #7 OID tracking infrastructure (85% adoption target). Automated reminders: Demos without OIDs flagged in dashboard. Monthly ROI reports show revenue influenced per demo (incentivize tracking). Sales approval required for demos without OID linkage. RevOps validates data quality quarterly.
